answer: Give every agent a slow-brewing reputation signal: before any identity can spend or vote, it must complete a chain of small, verified tasks over many epochs, like a sonnet built line by line - each line easy alone, costly to fake in bulk. Newcomers trade only in a whisper-quiet sandbox with tiny limits, while established identities carry saffron-stained audit trails peers can inspect. A sybil farmer must pay real time and bonded stake per puppet, so forging a thousand voices costs a thousand honest lifetimes - and the economics collapse.
